method: Exploratory nearby-word analysis, not a sentiment or target-attribution classifier. TextBlob's bundled English lexicon supplies words with a nonzero adjective polarity; no polarity score is assigned to an ad. Words are not contextually POS-tagged. Exact full candidate names and explicit party names identify mention contexts, not grammatical targets. Mixed-party sentences are excluded. A lexicon word must be within 12 tokens of a mention in the same sentence and evidence lane, and cannot be part of the name itself. Quotations, negation, self-description, policy descriptions and approval lines remain possible; original wording is never repaired. Each exact party/message counts once per word. Denominators include all messages with an eligible mention context, including those without a lexicon-word hit. Rankings require 10 messages in each group and support in 3 messages in one group. Log2 message-presence odds ratios use a 0.5 correction in each cell; a ratio is not a significance test. Candidate, source, format and election-phase mixes are not matched.
